when: 홈페이지 코드 전체 결함 점검을 할 때
lessons_to_port: Lane reports said "the build won't break", but it did break: session secret checked before `cookies()`, root not-found prerender hitting the DB. Always run a real `next build` at integration.
Run `next build` against a migrated scratch DB with no SESSION_SECRET, to mirror the Docker build.
Do 390/768/1440 screenshot QA. Use the live site as "before" and a local build as "after"; data differs, so compare styling only.
Watch for lane fixes that cause regressions. Example: a 4000-character cap on chat-lead transcripts would have rejected real leads, so it was changed to keep only the tail.
A production secret policy must not throw on values production may already use. Warn instead, so admins aren't locked out after deploy.
Mixed `@tiptap/*` versions get pulled in by `npm update`, because tiptap pins its peers exactly. Upgrade all tiptap packages together, or leave them alone.
Deploy is a separate decision. The NAS compose file is its own copy, so list what needs applying there.
(→ nas-docker-deployment로) Before swapping backup.sh, check the retention constants against the existing backup count. `BACKUP_KEEP=40` would have deleted 46 of 86 existing backups on the first run.
(→ nas-docker-deployment로) Cloudflare serves cached `/uploads` with the old 1-year immutable header until purged. Check the origin header with a `?cb=` query.

"게임 구성 폴더는 생략": exclude every file that has an ancestor directory containing an engine marker, not only files directly beside an exe.

Never run NAS-wide walks or per-item network work inside execute_code: a cell over 300 s kills the kernel and its state, and foreground terminal calls are capped at 600 s. Write a script to scratch that reads and writes JSON, run it in the terminal, and derive everything else from ONE index in memory.

Long reads over SMB (full hashes, big scans) go to `terminal(background=true, notify=true)` with a resumable JSON checkpoint. Use the wait to collect the user's decision rules via clarify, then end the turn with a one-line status.
Never move a `SteamLibrary` (contains `libraryfolder.vdf`) or another launcher-registered library, because the launcher loses the games. Give the user its address and ask.
Huge mixed media trees that contain a few games (e.g. a 3TB video tree): move only the game subfolders, never the whole tree.
Python `.exe` found in study/project folders (`cli.exe`, `python.exe` from setuptools or venvs) are not games. Check the context before classifying.

lessons_to_port: Precise post search with paging (7/page): `https://section.blog.naver.com/ajax/SearchList.naver?countPerPage=7&currentPage=N&keyword=Q&orderBy=sim&type=post` + Referer `https://section.blog.naver.com/Search/Post.naver?keyword=Q`. search.naver.com blog tab HTML gives only ~30 results and rewrites queries; cafe posts are mostly login-walled (skip).
Fetch `https://m.blog.naver.com/{id}/{logNo}` with an iPhone UA. Body starts at `class="post_ct` (works for SE2/SE3/SE-ONE).

Match the host with `(?:postfiles|blogfiles|mblogthumb-phinf|blogthumb|blogpfthumb-phinf)\.pstatic\.net/(Mj[^"'\\ ?]+)` — a `[a-z0-9]+\.pstatic` host pattern silently returns 0 images because the thumb hosts contain hyphens. The first image key of a post often 404s on `blogfiles` (it is the blog icon/thumbnail); skip failures, don't abort.
Posts fetched for TEXT (survey/evidence) need the same `post_ct` slice; strip `<script>` before tag-stripping or JS blobs pollute the text.
`data-width`/`data-height` in the HTML = uploaded original size; if <400 the original really is small (old mobile uploads are often 400px wide).

Search `<요리> 만들기` / `<요리> 레시피` / `"<정확한 이름>"` (2 pages each); recipe posts end with clean finished-plate shots, while `<요리> 후기`/brand searches return packaged retail goods and gift boxes. For a dessert with no hits under its exact name, try the generic form (`초코 구운찰떡`, `초코찰떡 오븐`).

Pull up to ~14 images per post (skip files <15 KB), one contact sheet per dish labelled `index:file widthpx`, then a second zoom sheet of the 10–20 finalists; pick finished food with no overlay text. A hand holding the food or a watermark is acceptable — the edit step removes it.
Keep `meta.json` {file → blog, logNo, url, key} while downloading; the chosen file's URL goes into the photo `sources.json` and the report.

Keyword phrasing decides recall: SearchList matches post prose, so search the words a poster would write (`다녀왔어요`, `허락받고 부착`, `설명회 X배너`), not topic nouns (`학원 포스터 학교` → mostly diaries). Run 10+ phrasings × 2–3 pages, dedupe on `blog/logNo` into a JSON file, then filter title+snippet with two regex groups (place AND object) before reading anything.
Titles can mislabel the field (e.g. a post titled 일식기능장 that is actually 복어기능장 material) - always look at the photos/documents.
write_file refuses to overwrite scratch files not fully read in this task; use a new file name or read first.
